translationRepairs: The grand empress dowager, treating Ping as Cheng’s heir, enfeoffed Chengdu—son of the Marquis of Taoxiang and great-grandson of Prince Si of Dongping—as king of Zhongshan to carry on Xing’s line.
The grand empress dowager, treating Ping as Cheng’s heir, enfeoffed Chengdu—son of Marquis Qing of Taoxiang and grandson of Prince Si of Dongping—as king of Zhongshan to carry on Xing’s line.

東平思王孫桃鄉頃侯子成都 makes Chengdu grandson (孫) of Prince Si and son of Marquis Qing (頃侯) of Taoxiang; “great-grandson” and the omitted posthumous 頃 are real errors, and the proposed wording matches the Chinese.
At this New Year's court audience, let him come with one son or younger brother. We enfeoff his son Xun with the four thousand three hundred households of Guangqi county as marquis of Guangqi."

詔與子男一人俱 specifies one son (子男); “or younger brother” is not in the Chinese and must be removed.
